speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a child with a 3-week history of fatigue, fever, easy bruising, and severe leg pain. To understand the cause of your illness, can you tell me exactly where the pain in your legs is located and what it feels like?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Leukemia (specifically Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia)

The combination of prolonged fatigue, easy bruising, fever, and severe leg pain waking a 4-year-old at night is highly suggestive of a bone marrow malignancy. To confirm this, I need to review the results of a Complete Blood Count (CBC) with differential and a Peripheral Blood Smear.
